name: Hot Climate Lightweight

intent_defaults.description: A warm-climate design direction exploring low bulk, ventilation, coverage and user-selected airflow and moisture preferences.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Relaxed or draped with user-controlled coverage and ventilation.

component_defaults.coverage: Coverage selected for activity and personal preference

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Breathability, thermal comfort, UV protection and moisture management are material- and construction-dependent.
This preset is not a sun-protective garment specification or heat-safety qualification.
